policy: Reconstruct the visible rainwater leader as a manufactured, wall-fixed drainage assembly. Source QA may reduce risk but never clears a rendered critical defect or awards Visual Fidelity points.

manufactureAndInstallation.manufacture: Representative late-1990s/circa-2000 Japanese exterior rainwater leader: round weather-resistant rigid PVC-U pipe sections with socket/coupler joints, separate galvanized wall bands/standoffs/anchor plates, a roof-line offset connection and a ground drain receiver. The current product references below establish generic construction principles only; they are not claimed as an exact historical product match.
components: continuous macro pipe body retained as the all-distance silhouette
four visible socket/coupler sleeves defining manufactured section joints
roof-line diagonal offset pipe and wall/scupper collar
ground receiver socket with deliberate insertion
manufactureAndInstallation.mounting: The pipe centreline is held roughly 120 mm proud of the facade reference plane; the rear pipe surface remains about 82.5 mm clear of the wall. Each visible band encircles the pipe, connects through a short stand-off arm to a discrete wall anchor plate, and uses two visible fastener heads. The lower pipe inserts into a larger ground receiver rather than stopping above the paving. The upper leader offsets back to a wall/scupper collar at the roof line.
manufactureAndInstallation.interfacesGapsSeals: Pipe-to-wall is a controlled stand-off, not a floating gap. Bands overlap the pipe radially without z-fighting. Wall plates sit against the facade plane. Coupler sleeves overlap the straight pipe body and hide section interfaces. The lower pipe inserts 10-35 mm into the receiver. The upper offset overlaps both the vertical body and wall collar so no open service-line gap is visible.
manufactureAndInstallation.orientation: Vertical leader on the camera-right/east end of the apartment facade; outward direction is +Z toward the benchmark cameras. Upper offset returns toward -Z into the wall/scupper collar.
manufactureAndInstallation.exposure: Fully exterior, strongly rain-exposed and partly sun-exposed. Wall-side recesses and coupler lower lips remain more sheltered; lower 0.5 m receives splash and persistent grime.
manufactureAndInstallation.aging: Cause-based only: mild PVC chalking/UV desaturation on outward faces, darker grime beneath socket lips and bands, localized ferrous residue only at galvanized fastener/bracket interfaces, and stronger splash/damp response at the ground receiver. No disaster, impact or reconstruction cues.
manufactureAndInstallation.geometryVsMaterialDetail: Pipe diameter, socket sleeves, stand-off distance, wall plates, fasteners, upper offset and ground receiver are geometry. PVC extrusion grain, fine scratches, chalking, galvanized crystal-scale breakup, water spotting and dirt films are material/microdetail; highlights must come from lighting/BRDF rather than albedo paint.

materials.microstructure: sub-millimetre extrusion/scuff structure only; no embossed fake seams
materials.wetnessResponse: rain darkens local grime and raises grazing reflectance modestly; benchmark remains dry unless the environment contract explicitly changes wetness
materials.uvAging: outward faces may desaturate/chalk slightly; avoid global uniform bleaching
materials.angularFresnelResponse: dielectric Fresnel only; grazing highlight strengthens physically while face-on response stays restrained

materials.specularF0: conductor response derived from metallic workflow; no dielectric-painted fake glints
materials.microstructure: fine galvanized crystalline breakup below silhouette scale
materials.wetnessResponse: small roughness reduction only when environment wetness is non-zero
materials.uvAging: minimal color shift; oxidation/dirt remains localized around water traps and anchors
materials.angularFresnelResponse: broad rough-metal grazing response, never a painted white highlight stripe

lodPolicy.lod0: Macro pipe body plus all couplers, bands, standoffs, plates, fasteners, roof-line offset/collar and ground receiver.
lodPolicy.lod1: Macro body plus major couplers/bracket forms through the existing DanchiHighDetail proxy classification; millimetre fasteners may disappear first.
lodPolicy.lod2: Macro pipe silhouette remains continuously rendered outside the accessory proxy set; small wall hardware is removed before it becomes sub-pixel.
lodPolicy.lod3: Macro pipe silhouette only. No new coarse replacement is introduced, avoiding a late silhouette swap.
lodPolicy.transitionSystem: Existing DanchiHighDetail four-level animated cross-fade; temporal evidence is still required to clear visible pop/shimmer.
